description: I’m new to state politics – and I’ll be honest, from the outside it looks like a game. But once you’re inside it, you realize quickly it’s no joke. Too many people treat lawmaking like a sport, where scoring points matters more than doing what’s right. But this isn’t a game – it’s people’s families,…

title: Vetting Candidates Doesn’t Divide Republicans — Dishonesty Does - Trevor Walter for Montana House District 69
